Reproducing the results requires understanding of complex eigenfrequency extraction, effective index calculation, and the specific definitions of equivalent propagation loss and modal overlap for a stationary mode. It involves several interacting physical parameters (Drude models, layer stack) and non-trivial math to translate into code. This is clearly beyond a textbook operation and demands significant domain knowledge.

There are only 2‑3 sequential stages, no complex data acquisition or fragile tool orchestration, and the environment requirements are minimal.
